propositions: Write operations (transition/claim/create) expose different parameter surfaces across lib, CLI, and MCP adapters, creating silent drift with no mechanical guard today

A conformance oracle must assert behavioral parity (including runtime conditional rules) across all three adapters via a single shared contract table, detecting divergence and parameter non-exposure automatically

MCP adapter gaps (force/reason/caused_by/ref not exposed on transition_ticket/claim_ticket) are captured as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, keeping the suite green until the MCP side lands
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be tested behaviorally on every adapter and reject identically
Adapter-bound internals (source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root) must be excluded from the contract to avoid false divergences
